findings.evidence: After the `simp only` at 201-202 the LHS is `letterPerm (a.1, a.2) (...)`; lines 144 and 152 of the same file already list `Prod.mk.eta` and `List.cons_append` explicitly for the identical reductions.

findings.issue: `wordAction_toBraid`'s cons case ends `rw [ih, letterPerm_apply]` followed by a bare `rfl`, which discharges two separate definitional facts — `(a.1, a.2) = a` and `(a :: u) ++ v = a :: (u ++ v)` — leaking defeq into the main induction rather than naming it.

summary: Proofs are mostly robust, but the cons-congruence step is duplicated verbatim inside the private permutation instead of being a reusable lemma, and two places lean on undocumented definitional equality (the Perm group-inverse chain and a trailing bare `rfl` doing `Prod` eta plus `List.cons_append`).
